items.title: [ClinicalTrials] A Phase 3 Study of Pelabresib (DAK539) and Ruxolitinib in Myelofibrosis (MF) (Phase 3, RECRUITING)
items.snippet: NCT ID: NCT07357727 | Sponsor: Novartis Pharmaceuticals | Condition: Primary Myelofibrosis (PMF), Post-polycythemia Vera Myelofibrosis (PPV-MF), Post-essential Thrombocythemia Myelofibrosis (PET-MF) | Phase: Phase 3 | Status: RECRUITING. The purpose of this trial is to evaluate whether treatment with pelabresib in combination with ruxolitinib leads to improved clinical outcomes compared to ruxolitinib alone in patients with primary myelofibrosis (PMF), post-polycythemia vera myelofibrosis (PPV-MF), or post-essential thrombocythemia myelofibrosis (PET-MF) who have not previously received Janus kinase (JAK) inhibitor therapy.

items.title: [ClinicalTrials] Talazoparib + Enzalutamide vs. Enzalutamide Monotherapy in mCRPC (Phase 3, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING)
items.snippet: NCT ID: NCT03395197 | Sponsor: Pfizer | Condition: mCRPC | Phase: Phase 3 | Status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING. This study compares rPFS in men with mCRPC treated with talazoparib plus enzalutamide vs. enzalutamide after confirmation of the starting dose of talazoparib in combination with enzalutamide.

items.title: [ClinicalTrials] Study of Daraxonrasib (RMC-6236) in Patients With RAS Mutated NSCLC (RASolve 301) (Phase 3, RECRUITING)
items.snippet: NCT ID: NCT06881784 | Sponsor: Revolution Medicines, Inc. | Condition: NSCLC (Non-small Cell Lung Cancer), Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer, NSCLC | Phase: Phase 3 | Status: RECRUITING. The purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety and efficacy of a novel RAS(ON) inhibitor compared to docetaxel.

items.title: [ClinicalTrials] A Study of Tucatinib or Placebo With Trastuzumab and Pertuzumab for Metastatic HER2+ Breast Cancer (Phase 3, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING)
items.snippet: NCT ID: NCT05132582 | Sponsor: Seagen, a wholly owned subsidiary of Pfizer | Condition: HER2 Positive Breast Cancer | Phase: Phase 3 | Status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING. This study is being done to see if tucatinib works better than placebo when given with other drugs to treat participants with HER2-positive breast cancer. A placebo is a pill that looks the same as tucatinib but has no medicine in it. This study will also test what side effects happen when participants take this combination of drugs.
